notes.title: Elysium – Official Gameplay Reveal Trailer Now Live!
notes.content:
[h3][b]Hey everyone,[/b][/h3][p]We're excited—and honestly, a little nervous—to share our first official gameplay trailer for [b]Elysium[/b]![/p][p]This short trailer will give you a taste of what's waiting for you in our sci-fi survival adventure: the haunting beauty of a fallen utopia, the thrill of uncovering ancient technology, and the intensity of confronting corrupted Elythian guardians. You'll also get a glimpse at our co-op base-building, exploration, and even riding around on a friendly bot or two.[/p][p]Your support means the world to our small indie team at Artifika Games. Every wishlist genuinely helps us reach more players, grow our community, and bring Elysium to life.[/p][p]We'd also love to hear your thoughts, so please drop by our Discord or leave us comments here—we promise to read and reply to as many as we can.

[url="https://discord.gg/2YWSrppKGM" style="button"]Join Elysium Official Discord Channel![/url][/p][p]Thanks so much for being part of the journey.
— Team Artifika
[/p][h3][b]Join us at the Steam Debut Festival (7–11 August)[/b][/h3][p]We'll be live-streaming and answering questions, and we'd love to see you there.[/p][p]See you in Elysium!

notes.title: Elysium v0.2.5 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h1]Elysium v0.2.5 Patch Notes[/h1]
Hey, survivors! We’re excited to share the latest updates to Elysium. This patch introduces new creatures, enhanced environments, a new gameplay feature, and a sneak peek at what’s coming next. Let’s dive in!

[h2]New Creatures[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Nimblix:[/b] A swift predator that thrives in the Elysiorite mines. Beware of its speed!
[*] [b]Mecha[/b]: A colossal humanoid machine, armed with orb cannons and a precision Elysiorite laser, standing as the ultimate guardian of the second LIT.
[/list]
[h2]Environmental Changes (Starter Island)[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]River and Waterfall:[/b] A serene yet dynamic addition, bringing life and sound to the Starter Island.
[*] [b]Tree Shaders and Colors Rework:[/b] Trees have been visually enhanced for a more vibrant and immersive world.
[*] [b]New Skybox with Environmental Effects:[/b] Experience breathtaking skies with richer lighting and depth.
[*] [b]Dynamic Weather:[/b] Rain, sunshine, and everything in between! Weather will now change dynamically to enhance exploration.
[/list]
[h2]Mechanics[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Save File Selection: [/b]You can now manage up to 5 save files, giving you more freedom to experiment and explore.
[*] [b]Loot Drop: [/b] Entities now drop loot on death.
[/list]
[h2]Upcoming[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]3D Map System: [/b]A new way to navigate the world of Elysium is on its way! Stay tuned for this game-changing feature.
[/list]

Thank you for being part of our journey as we continue to shape the world of Elysium. Share your thoughts on the new features, and remember—Elysium lives through those who dare!

– Team Artifika

notes.title: Elysium v0.2.3 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hey, survivors! This small update brings some fixes, visual upgrades, and a few tweaks to enhance your adventure.

[h2]Fixes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed the building preview material bug affecting all structures.
[*] Resolved NPC sync issues for better multiplayer gameplay.
[*] Fixed Rabbobo not spawning.
[*] Fixed walking through walls of some buildings
[*] Escape key functionality is now fully operational.
[*] Hotbar is fully operational.
[/list]

[h2]Improvements[/h2]

[list]
[*] Reworked Inventory System for smoother usability.
[*] Enhanced shadows and tree visuals for a more immersive world.
[/list]


Thanks for sticking with us as we continue to shape Elysium. Let us know what you think, and as always, happy surviving!

- Team Artifika

notes.title: Elysium v0.2.2 Patch
notes.content:
[h1][b]Elysium v0.2.2 Patch Notes[/b][/h1]

[h2][u][b]New Features[/b][/u][/h2]

[list]
[*] Save System & Autosave: Players can now save their progress and enjoy the convenience of autosave functionality.

notes.title: Welcome to Elysium: Your Survival Journey Begins
notes.content:
[b]Welcome to Elysium – A New World Awaits[/b]

We’re excited to officially introduce Elysium, an open-world sci-fi survival game currently in development by Artifika Games. Set in a beautifully crafted archipelago shaped by the rise and fall of an ancient civilization, Elysium challenges you to survive, explore, and innovate in a land filled with secrets and dangers.

[b]Key Features:[/b]

[b]Discover a Mysterious World:[/b] Explore diverse islands infused with the power of Elysiorite, uncover hidden secrets, and solve the mysteries of a fallen civilization.
[b]Craft and Build to Survive:[/b] Harvest resources to create high-tech tools, craft powerful suits, and build bases to defend yourself.
[b]Face Relentless Enemies:[/b] Battle robotic foes left behind by the Elythians, from swarming drones to massive war machines.
[b]Solo or Co-op Gameplay:[/b] Venture into Elysium alone or join friends to tackle its toughest challenges together.

[b]Stay Connected[/b]
This is just the beginning! We’ll be sharing regular updates on features, mechanics, and behind-the-scenes content as development progresses. To stay updated:

Add Elysium to your Steam wishlist so you don’t miss any announcements.
Join our Discord to connect with other survivors, share your ideas, and get exclusive sneak peeks.

[b]Welcome to Elysium. The adventure is just beginning.[/b]
